question: A species of grass named _____ is on the verge of extinction due to its insensitivity towards the environment.
solution:
The correct answer is __Hubbardia heptaneuron.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A species of grass named **Hubbardia heptaneuron **is on the verge of extinction due to its insensitivity towards the environment.
 
• At least **10 per cent of India’s recorded wild flora and 20 per cent of its mammals** are on the threatened list.
 
• Many of the flora and fauna on the threatened list would now be categorised as ‘**critical**’, like:
 
 
• the cheetah,
 
• pink-headed duck,
 
• mountain quail,
 
• forest spotted owlet, and
 
• plants like madhuca insignis (a wild variety of mahua) and
 
 
 
• **hubbardia heptaneuron,(a species of grass). **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The common sunflower **(Helianthus annuus)** is a large annual forb of the genus Helianthus grown as a crop for its edible oily seeds.
 
• **Saccharum officinarum **is a large, strong-growing species of grass in the genus Saccharum.
 
• **Bellis perennis, **the daisy, is a European species of the family Asteraceae, often considered the archetypal species of the name daisy.
